lines: Carry the atlas beyond the Overworld and chart a Nether Fortress bearing.

quest.cartographers_atlas.nether_meridia: The ink warped, but the line held. Let me see the meridian proof.
The Nether meridian is drawn. We have a road through heat now.
The meridian still needs the fortress bearing, blaze rods, and Nether Wart.
Bring blaze rods from the fortress route before I trust the meridian.
The supplies need a fortress bearing behind them.
The Nether meridian still needs its proof before I can close it.
Keep the hot ink away from the folio edge.
messages.quest.cartographers_atlas.nether_meridia: Return to the cartographer with the Nether meridian.
quest.cartographers_atlas.nether_meridia: The atlas survived an Overworld horizon. Now we find out if its lines can cross fire.
Find a Nether Fortress, bring blaze rods and Nether Wart, and do not let the map learn to burn.
The Nether page still needs a fortress bearing, blaze rods, and Nether Wart.
messages.quest.cartographers_atlas.nether_meridia: The blaze rods are ready for the meridian.
Bring 3 blaze rods for heat-proof bearings.
The Nether Wart is sealed for study.
Bring 8 Nether Wart from the fortress route.
The Nether fortress bearing is recorded.
quest.cartographers_atlas.nether_meridia: Reasonable. The Nether punishes casual curiosity.
Keep the page away from sparks.
Nether Fortress near {target_x}, {target_z}, about {distance} blocks {direction} in {target_dimension}. Bring 3 blaze rods and 8 Nether Wart.
I do not have your Nether meridian open right now.
The Nether meridian is already drawn.
The Nether mark refuses to settle from here.
The fortress mark is near {target_x}, {target_z}, about {distance} blocks {direction} in {target_dimension}. Bring blaze rods and Nether Wart.
The atlas needs one finished horizon page before its ink can survive the Nether.
messages.quest.cartographers_atlas.nether_meridia: Reach the Nether Fortress near {target_x}, {target_z} in {target_dimension}.
